title: TechBack
description: A circular-economy and technology venture focused on recovering value from unwanted, damaged, or unused devices through repair, refurbishment, resale, and device lifecycle management.
problem: Damaged, outdated, or unused electronic devices are frequently discarded or left idle while students, individuals, and small organizations face high barriers to accessing affordable, reliable hardware and trusted repair services.
approach: TechBack builds digital platforms and structured operational workflows around device diagnostics, repair tracking, refurbishment, resale, e-waste recovery, and lifecycle management—connecting device owners, technicians, and buyers into a practical circular ecosystem.
contribution: Developer at TechBack — contributing to web and mobile application development, relational database architecture, and user-facing platform workflows.
imageAlt: TechBack circular technology and device lifecycle platform preview

title: Access Point
description: A technology and computing business providing practical software, computing services, and digital solutions tailored to local clients and everyday operational needs.
problem: Many local businesses and individuals need dependable software tools, digital presence, and technical support without the complexity or cost of enterprise-grade foreign software.
approach: Delivers full-stack web platforms, database-backed business systems, and cross-platform mobile interfaces using reliable, maintainable web technologies.
contribution: Developer & builder — designing and implementing full-stack PHP/MySQL web systems and Flutter mobile interfaces.
imageAlt: Access Point technology and digital solutions overview

title: Link Mine
description: An applied research and development concept exploring mining safety, environmental monitoring, and resilient underground communication using IoT sensors, edge computing, and intelligent systems.
problem: Mining environments in Zambia and across the region face critical safety and communication challenges where conventional network connectivity can fail during emergencies.
approach: Investigates combining low-power IoT telemetry sensors, mesh/radio communication links, edge processing, and machine learning anomaly detection to improve situational awareness in harsh environments.
contribution: Research & system concept development — exploring sensor data pipelines, algorithmic thinking, and intelligent systems architecture.
imageAlt: Link Mine mining safety and communication R&D concept

title: Tripper
description: A travel technology prototype designed to connect local accommodation providers with corporate and business travel needs through a streamlined booking workflow.
problem: Local lodges and independent accommodation providers often struggle to reach corporate travelers who require predictable availability, invoicing, and reliable booking management.
approach: A web-based platform prototype focused on clear listing discovery, structured corporate booking requests, and simple management tools for local hosts.
contribution: Prototype developer — building the web interface, data model, and booking workflow prototype.
imageAlt: Tripper travel technology prototype connecting local accommodation and corporate travel
